evidence: Before the fix, each acceptance verify_command from the write root: hook-budget (R1), hook-budget-constraints-first (R3), hook-budget-omitted (R9), hook-budget-plain (R12) and hook-budget-whole (R8) failed; hook-budget-protocol (R2) passed, as a check acceptance. After the fix all six acceptance verify_commands pass (6 x "1 passed"). `uv run pytest tests/test_hooks.py tests/test_views.py -q -p no:cacheprovider`: 53 passed. README Testing command 1 (tests/canon): 268 passed. Command 2 (tests/tuner): 134 passed. Command 3 (rest of tests, -n auto): 1457 passed. Command 4 (tmux, serial): 19 passed, 1 failed: test_tmux_integration.py::test_prefix_a_popup_walks_six_tabs_counts_needs_you_reads_unsigned_checks_regains_focus_and_narrows_on_resize; rerun alone with -m tmux it passed (1 passed); judged flaky and unrelated because the test does not touch hooks. Real store probe: `printf '{"cwd":"/home/andrewyin/orchestra","session_id":"probe"}' | uv run orchestra hook-start --claude` gave additionalContext of 8893 characters, within 9000; it ends with "Not shown: evidence-layer, canon-cli-ergonomics, session-analysis, test-suite-speed. Run `orchestra handoff --effort <slug>`." then the "Other views" footer. Only changed file: orchestra/stage/hooks.py (+38/-25). Changes: removed MAX_HANDOFF_BYTES and _truncate; added HOOK_CONTEXT_BUDGET = 9000; raised MAX_HOOK_CONSTRAINTS from 8 to 20; added _assemble_start(constraint_lines, sections) building PROTOCOL, constraint lines, "# Project Handoff" plus effort sections, an optional "Not shown: a, b. Run `orchestra handoff --effort <slug>`." line, and the footer; it adds sections in position order (newest first) while the whole assembled string, including the Not-shown line and footer, stays at or under 9000 characters, and stops at the first section that does not fit; cmd_start calls _assemble_start; orchestra handoff output untouched; views.py not edited.
observations: Before the fix, the start hook put the handoff first and constraints after it, capped the handoff at 16384 bytes with a mid-section line truncation, above the 9000-character budget and the 10,000-character Claude Code cap. The context exceeded 9000 characters when the full handoff exceeded 10000; constraints came after the efforts; efforts were cut mid-section; no omitted effort was named. The plain (Cursor) format behaved the same because both formats share cmd_start.
root_cause: cmd_start had no character budget over the whole context. It used a 16384-byte line-boundary truncation (_truncate) of the handoff text alone, which cut efforts partway through, appended constraints after the handoff, and did not name omitted efforts, so the context could exceed the Claude Code 10,000-character additionalContext cap.
